Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a well-circumscribed, solitary nodular opacity in the right upper lobe apex with sharp margins, which is characteristic of a solitary pulmonary arteriovenous malformation (PAVM) rather than an ill-defined metastasis or granuloma. Options suggesting pneumothorax or complex AVM with multiple feeders are inconsistent with the single, discrete nodule seen on the plain film.
